title: Truthfulness of Scripture
definition: The truthfulness of Scripture means that God's Word is trustworthy because God Himself is truthful and cannot lie.
summary: The Bible faithfully communicates what God intends to reveal. Because God is perfectly true, His Word can be trusted in all that it teaches.
christFocus: Jesus described Himself as "the truth" and consistently affirmed the trustworthiness of Scripture. The truthfulness of Scripture points us to the Savior who is truth incarnate.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Believers can trust Scripture because its ultimate Author is God. God's promises, warnings, commands, and Gospel message are dependable.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Many people question whether truth can be known. Scripture provides a reliable foundation because it comes from the God who never deceives.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Trust God's Word even when culture, feelings, or circumstances suggest otherwise. Let Scripture shape your understanding of reality.
